## Description

An order to an external dental lab for a crown, bridge, denture or aligner: teeth, shade, material, instructions, due date and the lab from a clinic list. Status Sent → Received → Fitted; the fit visit is booked against the due date.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** An order prints or exports for the lab without data the lab does not need.
- [ ] **AC2.** Overdue orders show on the reception list.
- [ ] **AC3.** Fitting closes the order and the linked plan item.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
